BQ-EQ: Incremental or normalized returns on capital stay with BQ; do not score again as residual risk.
BQ-CASH: Level of realized cash stays in BQ; RG-UNC uses dispersion as a forecasting dependency.
BQ-RES: Concentration and cyclical earnings resilience stay in BQ; RG-RISK uses only contract remediation exposure distinct from demand.
FH-BS: Leverage and principal stay in FH; FX transaction mismatch affects earnings and settlement value at unchanged principal.
FH-LIQ: Rollover timing, deposit access and principal repayment remain in FH.
FH-STRESS: Stress FCF and survivability remain in FH; no duplicate penalty.
GQ-FWD: Backlog and growth expectations stay in GQ; delivery-remediation and FX conversion are separate.
GQ-INC: Productivity of invested capital stays in GQ.
IC-IND: Sector AI disruption stays in IC; issuer-specific acceptance, rework and skills remain separately assessed.
IC-POS: Relative wins and competitive position stay in IC; implementation risk is issuer-specific.
IC-CYCLE: Macro and sector cyclicality stay in IC.
VAL-PRIMARY: Valuation level stays in VAL; value sensitivity informs RG-UNC.
VAL-RET: Expected-return level stays in VAL; assumption sensitivity informs RG-UNC.
VAL-MOS: Intrinsic discount and payoff asymmetry stay in VAL; RG-UNC reviews distribution of scenarios.
WP7: ESOP authorization and disclosures belong in GOV; economic dilution, payout and allocation reserved for WP7.
